pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: match the two tables for 2023 and show each district ANC completed over registered percent with employed over enrolled percent
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: WITH filtered_data AS (SELECT anc.district, anc.year, anc.pregnancies_registered, anc.anc4_completed, liv.women_enrolled, liv.employed_at_6_months FROM anc_visits AS anc JOIN livelihoods AS liv ON anc.district = liv.district AND anc.year = liv.year WHERE anc.year = 2023 AND liv.year = 2023 AND anc.district IN ("Gaya", "Kishanganj", "Nalanda", "Patna", "Purnia") AND liv.district IN ("Gaya", "Kishanganj", "Nalanda", "Purnia")) SELECT district, (anc4_completed * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0), 0)) AS anc_completed_percent, (employed_at_6_months * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(women_enrolled, 0), 0)) AS employed_enrolled_percent FROM filtered_data
